summary: Main_Inference_V1 completed operationally but failed quality and safety SLOs. The UI reasoning layer maps each failed SLO to a bottleneck and only exposes catalog-backed optimizations that survived compatibility and negative-rule filters.
title: Optimization Intelligence For Main_Inference_V1
